items.summary: The Social.Wiki framework enables anyone to easily edit social websites within the system, while allowing them to choose the content they see.
items.zh: 新系统让用户可以更好地控制自己的在线体验

items.title: ULA's Vulcan rocket is set to return to flight on Friday the 13th
items.summary: This Vulcan launch will be first to use a full complement of 6 solid rocket boosters.
items.zh: ULA 的火神火箭将于 13 日星期五返回飞行

items.title: Capturing the complete process of embryonic development
items.summary: By tracking over 1 million cells, researchers created a detailed map of embryonic development in mice. It could provide development and disease insights.
items.zh: 捕捉胚胎发育的完整过程

items.title: How the biggest Alzheimer’s risk gene disrupts the process of insulating neurons
items.summary: MIT researchers showed that the APOE4 gene variant suppresses molecular signaling needed for oligodendrocytes to myelinate neurons and also demonstrated a proof-of-concept fix.
items.zh: 最大的阿尔茨海默病风险基因如何破坏神经元的绝缘过程

items.title: A soft robot could help doctors diagnose and treat disorders of the small intestine
items.summary: MIT engineers designed a robotic enteroscope that can inch through the hard-to-reach small intestine, making biopsies and drug delivery easier.
items.zh: 软机器人可以帮助医生诊断和治疗小肠疾病

items.title: How Spiders Spin ‘Silk Dope’ Into Nature’s Toughest Material
items.summary: By probing its molecular structure, biologists are uncovering how a tangle of unstructured proteins turns into a tough, flexible thread. The post How Spiders Spin ‘Silk Dope’ Into Nature’s Toughest Material first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 蜘蛛如何将“丝液”纺成自然界最坚硬的材料

items.title: Three-quarters of NFL football players may end up with CTE
items.summary: The first estimate of CTE prevalence across the NFL suggests 75 percent of players may suffer from the neurodegenerative disease.
items.zh: 四分之三的 NFL 橄榄球运动员可能最终患有 CTE

items.title: A hidden ocean change near Antarctica could have global consequences
items.summary: Antarctic waters are getting saltier as sea-ice loss reshapes ocean circulation.
items.zh: 南极洲附近隐藏的海洋变化可能会产生全球后果

items.title: Why do flamingos dance while they eat? This scientist found out
items.summary: Beautiful ripples drew Víctor Ortega Jiménez to feeding flamingos. Unraveling their secret could inspire new ways to filter water.
items.zh: 为什么火烈鸟吃东西时会跳舞？这位科学家发现

items.title: Comets probably didn’t deliver life’s building blocks to Earth
items.summary: Most comets would have hit Earth with too much speed and at too sharp an angle for life-giving molecules to survive impact, a new study suggests.
items.zh: 彗星可能没有将生命的组成部分送到地球

items.title: Vibe genes? Natural(ish) language comes to protein, genome design software
items.summary: You can apparently now tell AI tools what sort of protein you want them to make.
items.zh: 氛围基因？自然语言引入蛋白质、基因组设计软件

items.title: Sculpture re-creates odd optical effects of famed Lycurgus Cup
items.summary: University of Sheffield researchers figured out how to re-create the 1,600-year-old glass recipe.
items.zh: 雕塑再现了著名的莱克格斯杯的奇怪光学效果
